name: RelPro
description: RelPro turns company and people data into quality leads and actionable intelligence, right inside your AI assistant. Search by firmographics like revenue and industry codes, maturing filings and loans, competing lenders, buyer intent topics, and more. Once your target list has been narrowed and prioritized, pull the full profile details: the right people with accurate contact data, plus UCC filings, SBA loans, Form 5500, government contracts, and CRE. Pair it with your CRM to enrich records and flag triggers like a maturing loan or an expiring filing. From people and firmographics to filings and loans, RelPro brings trusted data right where you work.

_published_faq.name: How do I add RelPro to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add RelPro to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.relpro.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the RelPro MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: RelPro provides these MCP tools: company_executives_search, company_premium_profile, company_premium_search, company_profile, company_search, person_profile, and person_search.

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to RelPro in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
RelPro requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
